{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
print("First few revenue values:")
print(data['revenue'].head())

# Check for unusual values (e.g., 999999.99)
print("\nUnique revenue values:")
print(data['revenue'].unique())

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"\nRows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Show the first few rows with commas
print("\nFirst few rows with commas:")
print(data[has_commas].head())"}
